qualification: Air and Mini each passed 24 Direct + 11 Graph cases and two separate header checks. W1 passed 23 Direct + 11 Graph plus headers before correcting the one obsolete refusal assertion; only the changed Direct case was rerun and passed. All other tests and product code are identical. This is explicitly incremental W1 evidence, not a claim that its first full test invocation passed.
Initial test-construction compilation errors and the obsolete refusal assertion are retained. No product, numeric algorithm or tolerance correction was required after the immutable product candidate.
W1/Air installed validation layers reported no Validation Error, VUID or SYNC-HAZARD. Mini is correctness/portability only and has no installed validation layer.

F32/F16/BF16 three gates in packed/separate form, odd byte strides and View origins, empty/tails and rank-eight broadcast use independent FP64 activation and storage-rounding checks. Captured aligned F32 SiLU also exercises the retained ggml GLU shell with corrected IEEE boundaries.

RMSNorm/LayerNorm use F32 accumulation and independently typed scale/bias without narrowing parameters. Widths 0/1/127/128/129/257/2048, 1/2/3 rows, rank-eight, zero strides, odd origins, zero epsilon, NaN/Inf and large-mean small-variance rows passed. Exact affine cancellation proves F32 learned parameters survive through final storage rounding.

One native normalization dispatch, fixed shared memory, paired odd half rows and no extra device scratch. Fixed Recorder tests verify adjacent guard bytes; the ordinary gate/norm/residual Graph reports four dispatches/three reused output blocks and keeps shared constants, independent slots and old results across close.

Preparation binds native rules; execution does no provider search or timing. Existing qualified ggml GLU addressing/dispatch is preserved where alignment is provable; the new numeric adapter and normalization have not yet passed the full-C1 P1 gate.
